summary: If you can see exactly what would make the situation easier right now, do that before the problem grows into something harder to manage.
body: If you can see exactly what would make the situation easier right now, do that before the problem grows into something harder to manage. When the Moon sextiles Mars, concern moves naturally into action, making small practical responses especially effective. Make the call, cover the shift, fix the thing, bring the food, or handle the immediate piece that buys everyone more breathing room. You do not need to solve the whole situation for one useful action to matter.
